results.want: Classic caster: cold spells, all the spell damage and all the energy shield it can find.
Strength sword build: all the life, all the armour and all the sword damage.
Two-handed mace slams: big hits, area, stun, life and armour.
Mace and shield: block, armour and life first, mace damage after.
Totems and warcries: totem damage, warcry effect, life and regeneration.
Spell totems from the Zealot: totem damage and speed, spell and elemental damage, a staff, life and energy shield.
Physical bow: bow damage, attack speed, crit, evasion and life.
Elemental bow: elemental damage with attacks, penetration, attack speed, evasion.
Poison bow, across the map: poison and chaos with bow attacks, evasion and life.
Fire and lightning caster on life: spell damage, crit, life, mana.
Summoner: minion damage, minion life and speed, auras, energy shield or life.
Wand attacks: wand damage, attack speed, crit, energy shield.
Axe bleed: bleed chance and damage, axe damage, leech and life.
Dual-wielding swords or axes: dual wield damage, speed and crit, life, evasion.
Burning fire caster: fire damage, burning, ignite, life and energy shield.
Staff caster who blocks: staff and spell damage, spell block, life and energy shield.
Aura and brand support caster: auras, reservation, brands, spell damage, life.
Dagger crit attacker: dagger damage, crit, attack speed, evasion and dodge.
Poison claws: claw damage, poison, chaos, attack speed, evasion.
Traps and mines: trap and mine damage, throwing speed, area, energy shield and evasion.
Dagger caster: spell damage and crit with a dagger, cast speed, energy shield.
Two-handed fire melee: fire damage with attacks, two-handed damage, life, armour.
Shield caster: spell block and attack block, spell damage, energy shield and life.
Lightning and physical spells from the Zealot: spell damage, shock, cast speed, life and energy shield.
Channelled spells: channelling damage, spell damage, cast speed, mana and its sustain, energy shield.
Fire attacks with a sceptre: sceptre and fire attack damage, burning, attack speed, life and armour.
Curses and chaos spells: curse effect, more curses, chaos and damage over time, energy shield.
Dodging blades from the Shade: dodge, spell dodge, evasion, crit, dagger or claw damage.
A Reaver who casts: spell damage and cast speed with a one-handed weapon, life and armour.
An axe that curses on hit: curse effect, damage against the cursed, axe damage, life and armour.
Dexterity sword and shield: block, evasion, life, sword damage and melee crit.
Lightning strikes with a one-handed weapon: lightning attack damage, shock, attack speed, life and evasion.
